title: Akiyama Mizuki — Peace And Donuts!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, there they are...
Hey, you guys!
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Welcome, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What brings you here today?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I have something for all of you.
Let's see... I guess no KAITO or MEIKO today?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, you seem to have just missed them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay.
That's a bit of a shame since I wanted to see their reactions... But I can just give these to them later!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
The thing is, I brought gifts for everyone.
I got to go to a carnival the other day.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: A carnival...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's an amusement park that's kinda like a circus since they travel around from place to place.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
And it was so cute!
Everything they had from the rides to the food was all cat themed!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, there were cats everywhere...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, because the owner loves them so much!
It really felt like every surface had a cat painted on it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Naturally, the souvenirs I bought are also...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ta-daa! Cat keychains!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wow, these are really cute...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They had all sorts of different breeds, so I made sure to get ones that suited each of you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, to be fair, I sorta arbitrarily picked based on my own personal beliefs about you guys...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, I'm curious to see what you chose.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I bet you are. By the way, I already gave Kanade and the others theirs.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I got Kanade a Russian Blue, Mafuyu a Chartreux... And a Scottish Fold for Ena!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I don't really know cats, but it sounds like they come in a lot of different types.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What are those ones like?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, right. Their names alone don't tell you much, huh? Alright, lemme find some pictures...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Russian Blues look like this.
They've got emerald green eyes and ash blue coats.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Their eyes are so pretty...
This is the breed you chose for Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, they remind me of her since they seem distant but actually have a high degree of empathy.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: As for Mafuyu, I thought a Chartreux matched her calm demeanor and kind heart.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What about Ena?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wh-What was it called again...? A Scottish something...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
A Scottish Fold.
Hmm... Oh, here we are. They look like this.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: They're cute...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, they do remind me of Ena...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Right? I thought the same thing! In particular, that kind of in-your-face cuteness!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Unfortunately, she got mad at me when I told her that...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Really? I think you were spot on, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Which breed did you choose for me?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, I wanna ask the same question...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Then, I'll start passing them out!
Here you are!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You got me a white cat...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That's a Khao Manee cat.
I thought it suited you since it has a bit of a mythical feel to it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, its eyes are different colors...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Just like me...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Mine has a black nose and blue eyes...
What is this breed called?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's a Himalayan. They've got this sort of mysterious aura to them, but they're actually good with people. Doesn't that sound like you, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Ah, so that's how you see me.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: My cat looks so fluffy. I think it's really cute...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Mine kinda looks like a leopard.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yours is a Minuet, Len, and yours is a Bengal, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Minuets not only look cute, but are also supposed to be really kind. That reminded me of you, Len. And despite how fierce Bengals look, they're actually really friendly. Like you, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I don't think we're alike...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! You totally are!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Still...
It's unfortunate that we don't get to see MEIKO and KAITO's reactions.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know. But I'll let you guys know how they react once I give them their gifts!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Actually, that might not be for a little while since I'm gonna be a bit busy...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You are?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah. See, the carnival I went to is gonna close down soon.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And I get to help out with the show they're gonna put on for the final day!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
A show?
Does that mean you're going to be acting, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yup!
I'm really excited since it's such a fun story♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What is it about?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, want me to tell you?
It's about this cat hero who protects the carnival from...
